speaker: Doctor
text: Let's start from the beginning: can you describe exactly when the bleeding after your wisdom tooth extraction began and how long it has been going on? Also, do you have a history of easy bruising or bleeding in other areas, such as your nose or gums?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth. The bleeding from the surrounding gums was minimally responsive to multiple gauze packs. The patient also has a history of easy bruising. Family history includes the patient's uncle who had similar issues with bleeding and a history of easy bruising and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That family history of joint swelling and bleeding in your uncle is very concerning for a clotting factor deficiency. Has this bleeding pattern been present since childhood, and do you experience excessive bleeding after minor cuts or vaccinations? Also, have you ever required blood transfusions or clotting factor concentrates for surgeries in the past?

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) and Platelet Function Assay.
REQUEST TEST: PT/INR and aPTT.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hematologic tests show Hematocrit at 35%, Leukocyte Count at 8,500/mm3, and Platelet Count at 160,000/mm3. Prothrombin Time is 15 sec, Partial Thromboplastin Time is 60 sec, Bleeding Time is 6 min, Fibrin Split Products are Negative, and Peripheral Blood Smear shows normal-sized platelets.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A (Factor VIII deficiency).
